description: This file is a Spring configuration class for setting up messaging with ActiveMQ in the Fineract project. It configures connection factories, message listener containers, and JMS templates for handling notifications via a message queue.

classes.name: MessagingConfiguration
classes.description: A Spring configuration class for setting up ActiveMQ messaging components, including connection factories, message listeners, and JMS templates, conditioned on 'activeMqEnabled' profile and 'EnableFineractEventsCondition'.

methods.name: loggerBean
methods.description: Creates and returns a Logger instance for the class.

methods.name: amqConnectionFactory
methods.description: Initializes and configures an ActiveMQConnectionFactory with broker URL, defaulting to 'tcp://localhost:61616' or overridden via environment property.

methods.name: connectionFactory
methods.description: Creates a CachingConnectionFactory wrapping the ActiveMQ connection factory.

methods.name: jmsTemplate
methods.description: Creates and configures a JmsTemplate for sending JMS messages.

methods.name: messageListenerContainer
methods.description: Sets up a DefaultMessageListenerContainer to listen on 'NotificationQueue' with the specified message listener and exception handler.
